text.tspan: Median income per year (after tax) 1963 to 2024
Level of income per year below which 50% of the population falls. This data is adjusted for inflation and
differences in living costs between countries. Income here is measured after taxes and benefits.

tspan.tspan: This data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Income has been equivalized.
